## What changes

State the exact claim, computation, formal statement, or repository behavior changed.

## Evidence and validation

List the commands run, relevant output, citations, and the evidence state earned.

## Review scope

Identify assumptions, unresolved points, and the independent review required.

## Machine-assistance disclosure

Name any AI systems or automated tools used, what they produced, and what the human
contributor personally checked and understands.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and the current `workspace/PROGRESS.md`.
- [ ] I updated affected claim and status files.
- [ ] I checked citations against the cited source.
- [ ] I preserved failed approaches and contradictory evidence.
- [ ] I ran `python3 scripts/verify.py --quick`.
- [ ] I did not describe numerical evidence as proof.
- [ ] I did not mark my own work as independently reviewed.
- [ ] I agree to contribute this change under Apache-2.0.
